newsitem.title: UK: Inchcape ahead on Kleinwort recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Inchcape ahead on Kleinwort recommendation.

text.p: Inchcape Plc, the distribution and car retailing group, saw its shares move ahead after Kleinwort Benson recommended buying the stock, market makers said on Thursday.
The shares were nine pence up at 270 pence by 1426 GMT. Trading volume was 17.10 million.
The analyst at Kleinwort Benson who follows Inchcape was not immediately available for comment.
Dealers said there had been a single trade of around eight million shares, but knew no further details. --London Newsroom +44 71 324 7974
